page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Christiano populo, concessum sine reverentia in sacra inquirere; nec prophetis ipsis absque tremore faciem Dei ([illegible, ~12 letters]) accipias) intueri.
main_text.head: Nunquam deest locutuleiis obtrectandi materia.
main_text.p: Multò minùs malevolo animo rabiosè infectantibus. Moderatione imperii in urbe focia, laudanda Livori nec magis quam reprehendenda, Germanicus usus fuerat. defit pabu-lum. Laudem pro crimine arripiens Pisò, civitatem Athenien-sium turbido incessu territam oratione sua inerepat: obliquè Germanicum perstringens, quod contra decus Romani nominis non Atheniensis tot cladibus extinctos, sed colluviem illam nationum comitate nimia coluisset. At idem Pisò infrà magnificentiam convivii, & coronam Germanico acceptam, modò humilitatem modò superbiam, increpat. Ita detractandi furor rabiosae linguae venenum ex omni occasione colligit. Quid Germanico contra haec remedii? diffi-Remedia mulatio[?], patientia, beneficentia. noverat enim, qua livoris. autoritate occulti mandati nixus Pisò, tantae se audaciae accingeret: aut insita naturae bonitate malitiam alienam vincere conabatur. Solatium capere Germanicus ex illo Salluftii, aut cujuscunque denique, poterat: vives interdum fortuna, sape invidia, fatigat: ubi anima natura cessit, demptis obtrectatoribus ipsa se virtute magis magisque extollit. Orat.2.ad Caesarem De Republica Ordinanda.
main_text.head: Seipsam plerumque contradicendo redarguit convitiatio.
main_text.p: Quos modò colluviem nationum pro Atheniensibus Pisò vocaverat, iis vetera objectabat, quae in Ma-Immemorcedones improsperi[?], violenter in suos fecissent. Si non fui maledi- sunt Athenienses, tot cladibus extincti, quid iis clades aut a Philippo, aut a Demetrio accepta; quid ingratus in Miltiadem, Themistoclem, Phocionem, alios benè centia.

page.notes: Greek word after "Dei (" is unreadable at this scan resolution; the bracket marks its approximate length. "mulatio" is doubtful (possibly "mutatio"). "improsperi" is doubtful. Marginal notes are split across lines as printed; the second and third note fragments were joined into full notes where they run over a line end. The Latin paragraph at the foot ends mid-sentence ("alios benè") and continues on the next page.
